overview.description: The Simplify US Equity PLUS Bitcoin Strategy ETF (SPBC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund is actively managed to invest in US equities and spot Bitcoin ETPs. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation SPBC was launched on May 24, 2021 and is issued by Simplify.

completeness: holdings are every tracker row whose FUND NAME matches this fund, all dated 2026-10-12
the tracker URL is date-stamped and is rediscovered from the fund page on each call; the newest published tracker date is used
the provider states weights as fractions of market value; the fixed conversion is *100 and weight_raw keeps the provider value, with no sum gate because futures exposure can push the total above 1
quantity units come from the provider's Security Master Asset Group: Fund shares, Future contracts, Cash currency
the Notional Coverage column holds an uncalculated spreadsheet formula, so notional stays null rather than being invented
no OHLC history is published on this route
